definitions.explanation: A method of rapid writing using abbreviations and symbols to record speech quickly.

examples.japanese: {速記|そっき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
{速記|そっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{議事|ぎじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{速記|そっき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記録|きろく}される→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Diet proceedings are recorded in shorthand.

notes:
{速記|そっき} is used for rapid transcription of speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速記|そっき}{者|しゃ} (stenographer)
- {速記|そっき}{録|ろく} (shorthand notes)
- {速記|そっき}{術|じゅつ} (stenography technique)

USAGE:
While shorthand was historically important for recording meetings and court proceedings, it has largely been replaced by audio recording and digital transcription in modern contexts.
